_comment: CERTUS QUARTZ OUT OF GRANITE, in the demolition yard (owner, 2026-08-20, #276).
Granite is 20-40% quartz by volume, and separating quartz from crushed granite is what a real
aggregate plant does. That is the standard this mod holds itself to elsewhere - neodymium from
hard drive actuators, grog from fired ceramic, ground slag as fertiliser - and it is why the
feed is granite rather than any of the other six rubble shards. Diorite and andesite are the
same family with less quartz, so the geology already ranks a poorer second route if one is
ever wanted.
SEPARATING because granite is a MIXTURE of quartz, feldspar and mica. Pulling the quartz out
is division. The Pulverizer would give a powder, and AE2's certus dust is downstream of the
crystal rather than a substitute for it - the crystal is what charges, and charged certus is
the workhorse of the whole mod at eleven recipes.
TWO PER FEED, because a playthrough wants 4 to 8 stacks (owner). At one apiece that is roughly
3200 pulls of Stone Rubble; at two it is about 226 blocks, which is a real dig without being a
wall. The OUTPUT COUNT is the lever here rather than the drop weight: granite's 60 of 370 in
rubble_pulls is already balanced against the six shards beside it and should not move.
TEMPORARY, and guarded. This is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship
data on 26.1.2; it leaves with the press pool - Flatts3000/trashlands#46.
The neoforge:mod_loaded guard is load-bearing rather than tidy. Strip it and this file does not
merely fail to apply, it fails to PARSE on its own result id - measured on the Simple Magnets
overrides in #271 - and one bad recipe file leaves a single ERROR line in an otherwise green run.
